goal.objective: Replace the mutable R2 generated-runtime trust root with an authenticated, exact-candidate-derived runtime whose complete source, dependency supply, build, and generated module closure are stable and reconstructable before any semantic decision.

assumptions.statement: Node itself remains external host supply, while every repository-derived module and copied npm package executed by the R2 tools is authenticated and bound before use.
assumptions.rationale: The file-based kernel cannot attest the IDE or OS runtime, but it can prevent repository-live generated code and unbound npm package resolution.

assumptions.statement: The integration owner retains full verification, successor freeze, exact gate, fresh R2, hosted CI, and merge authority.
assumptions.rationale: The correction specialist cannot approve the release it modifies.

assumptions.statement: Candidate f4f91a373dd7f8028ec5d592e89c75f0027245c3 and all of its exact gate and R2 evidence remain immutable.
assumptions.rationale: The authenticated fix outcome requires a new successor candidate.

assumptions.statement: One specialist owns the coupled harness, verifier, and regressions; the integration owner independently reviews and performs release gates.
assumptions.rationale: Splitting a shared bootstrap trust boundary would introduce conflicting edits and ambiguous ownership.

acceptanceCriteria.description: R2 prepare, compile, approve, and handoff verification execute no repository-live generated module and reconstruct one closed candidate-runtime identity before semantic decisions.

evidenceRequirements.description: Provide exact changed-file, trust-binding, mutation-test, focused-test, build, template-checker, formatter, linter, and diff evidence.
